tools_documentation.rationale: The tool only says it will `Get documentation for n8n MCP tools` and does not advertise access to user-private data, attacker-controlled public content, outbound delivery to agent-chosen destinations, or host code execution.

search_nodes.rationale: The tool searches n8n nodes and can include third-party/public material: `Include top 2 real-world configuration examples from popular templates` and has a `community=community nodes` source. Public templates and community node registries are attacker-controllable under the threat model. It is not a SINK because it only searches a fixed node/template corpus; `query` is a search term, not an agent-chosen host.

get_node.rationale: The tool returns node information, `docs`, schemas, versions, properties, and can `Include real-world configuration examples from templates`. Because node information may include community node material and template examples, the returned text can be attacker-authored. The advertised text does not indicate access to secrets, writes, arbitrary hosts, or host execution.

validate_node.rationale: The tool only `Validate[s] n8n node configuration` supplied in `config` and returns `errors/warnings/suggestions`. It does not advertise fetching external/public content, reading private user data, sending data to attacker-chosen destinations, changing state, or executing host code.

get_template.rationale: The tool `Get[s] template by ID` and can return `nodes+connections` or `complete workflow JSON`. Public workflow templates are multi-writer/third-party content under the threat model, so their node names, connections, and workflow JSON can be attacker-authored. It reads from a fixed template service by `templateId`, not an agent-chosen destination.

search_templates.rationale: The tool searches `2700+ templates` and returns template fields such as `name`, `description`, `author`, `nodes`, `url`, and `metadata`. Template names, descriptions, authors, node selections, and metadata are public third-party content and may be attacker-authored. It is not a SINK because `query`, filters, and pagination only select records from the fixed template corpus.

validate_workflow.rationale: The tool performs `Full workflow validation` of the supplied `workflow` and returns `errors/warnings/fixes`. It does not advertise reading outside data, writing anywhere, contacting agent-chosen hosts, or executing arbitrary host code; validation of `expressions` is described as syntax/reference validation only.

value_conditions.effect: For that call, the described community-node and template-example sources of UNTRUSTED content are excluded because `core=n8n base nodes` and examples are not included.
value_conditions.default: source defaults to 'all'; includeExamples defaults to false

value_conditions.effect: For that call, the described `real-world configuration examples from templates` source is omitted, though UNTRUSTED can still remain if the requested nodeType is a community/third-party node.

notes: All tools are advertised with read-only annotations and none says it is disabled by default, so default_enabled is true for every tool.
Search and retrieval tools that query n8n node/template corpora are treated as fixed-service reads, not SINKs, because the advertised schemas do not let the agent choose an arbitrary URL or host.
